_doc: Overrides of the wood_planks and wood_bark worker (layout as tools/materials/overrides.json).
wood_planks b: grain 0 along u, 1 along v (the default), +2 pale weathered grey wood (low saturation is wood; only dark greys are metal).
wood_bark b: fissures 0 along v (the default), 1 along u, +2 pale bark (bright greys are bark, not snow).
a: relief from the art's luminance; lowered on 32x32 textures, whose texels are big on screen.

4dd02f._note: painted totem: grain kept weak by the paint key

d76cbc._note: white clapboards: pale, so only the dark hinges are metal

0d55c0._note: bamboo: smooth and glossy, the fissures faint
